status: fixed before any foundation-model inference on CARE; owner decisions of 2026-10-17

inherits.unchanged: split and folds, availability = record time + 600 s, score max(abs(y - p50)/R) over the two temperatures, per-method 99.5% calibration threshold with strict >, OPEN/CLOSE after 3 consecutive, gap/file-end reset, primary hit, false-alarm counting, primary metrics

data_status: the CARE test has been read (own-model results saved): development material, not an unknown holdout; no business pass/fail or production decision from this comparison

methods.own_model: saved SmallForecaster 5-fold predictions, thresholds and alarms; no retraining, re-inference or retuning
methods.baselines: saved load-bin temperature medians, common and native support

foundation_model_protocol.context: the same 128 past rows [n-128, n) of the 3 signals in native units as the own model
foundation_model_protocol.roles: TimesFM and Chronos: the two temperatures are targets and power is a past-only covariate; Toto: all three signals are variates (adapter defaults)
foundation_model_protocol.request: horizon 1, quantiles [0.5] only; alarms use the lead-1 p50 as in the inherited contract
foundation_model_protocol.support: the own model's common-support rows only; an adapter failure on a row makes that row unsupported for that method, recorded, never filled
foundation_model_protocol.calibration: per fold, the inherited calibration segment (last 30% of the validation anchor prefix), same score, per-method 99.5% threshold, same alarm rules

metrics.inherited: asset-macro recall, false episodes per 1000 normal record-hours, normal alarm-time fraction, earliness with misses counted; counts, pooled, per event, per asset, support
metrics.lead_time_rule: an event counts as detected at W if its primary-hit OPEN is at or before the shifted event_end availability time minus W; W = 0 is the inherited primary hit; event_end is not guaranteed to be the failure time, so the lead time is a proxy
metrics.per_event_table: detection, OPEN time and lead proxy of every method for every anomaly event
metrics.significance: 12 anomaly events only: no significance claims

acceptance: none in this run; the required lead time and the allowed false-alarm rate are set by the owner after seeing the comparison
procedure: separate Python environment for the foundation models; record package versions and downloaded checkpoint revisions and hashes
infer the calibration and test segments of all 5 folds for every method; save predictions, scores, thresholds and alarms; hash and freeze them
only then the evaluator reads the labels and scores every method (inherited order)
CARE-derived inputs, predictions and labels stay in the gitignored artifacts/; only hashes and summaries are committed
stop: inference failure, nonfinite values or overruns are recorded and stop the run; no change of inputs, context length, thresholds or support after results exist
out_of_scope: longer contexts, other covariate treatments, fine-tuning, the official CARE score
